data.gender_notes: Basila is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘basalah’ which means ‘to grow, flourish, or be abundant.’ In Islamic tradition, Basila symbolizes growth, prosperity, and a connection to nature. The name Basila carries the meaning “Vine, vegetation, flourishing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Basila usually hope their child will grow to embody vine, vegetation, flourishing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
